systems.country_label: National Security Information System; National Identification Register
systems.owner: NIRA; technology partner Tahaluf under a contract signed 8 July 2024
systems.tiers: new data centre at a co-location site; 5,665 kits for 135 districts and 11 cities, down to parish level; first modules (new registration, renewal, first ID at 16, replacement, change of particulars) due live 17 December 2024

systems.country_label: Mass Enrolment and Renewal Exercise; 53-day mobile registration outreach from 27 September 2024
systems.owner: NIRA with the Ministry of Internal Affairs
systems.tiers: mobile outreaches at sub-county headquarters, parishes, schools and places of worship; Cabinet budget UGX 666.85 billion, UGX 300 billion appropriated December 2023

note: Identity enrolment only: the new system's first modules are all national ID functions, and the statement says nothing about the registration of births or deaths.
